Name: Prettier Prize Ticket Machine and Menu
Author: bananasalmon
Description:
[size=3][b]Introduction[/b][/size]
Replace the prize ticket machine and its menu! I never really liked the button, and thought the yellow menu never matched the completely red machine.

On the menu, instead of a button, there will be a ticket slot through which your prize tickets will go.

The prize ticket machine also got a bit of yellow, so it doesn't feel like the yellow prize menu comes out of nowhere from a fully red machine.

[size=3][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
Compatible with Useable Community Center, which takes over both changes.

[size=3][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
To replace the machine sprites I use 'overlay', which requires Content Patcher 2.9.0 or higher.

[size=3][b]Credits[/b][/size]
Thanks to the Content Patcher documentation!
